answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one tide weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The harbor report shows the merge explicitly at each delta. Because of that, an attacker who spins up 80 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 85 times the capital for one share. A farm of 680 identities would post 4765 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
